question: What was total net revenue in FY2025?
gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.order_total_usd - COALESCE(r.refund_usd, 0)), 2)
FROM workspace.gold.fact_orders o
JOIN workspace.gold.dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN workspace.gold.dim_date d ON d.date = o.order_date
LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_usd) AS refund_usd
           FROM workspace.gold.fact_refunds GROUP BY order_id) r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test_account
  AND d.fiscal_year = 2025

question: By what percentage did net revenue grow from FY2025 to FY2026?
gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(100 * (SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 2026 THEN o.order_total_usd - COALESCE(r.refund_usd, 0) END)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 2025 THEN o.order_total_usd - COALESCE(r.refund_usd, 0) END) - 1), 2)
FROM workspace.gold.fact_orders o
JOIN workspace.gold.dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN workspace.gold.dim_date d ON d.date = o.order_date
LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_usd) AS refund_usd
           FROM workspace.gold.fact_refunds GROUP BY order_id) r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test_account
mv_sql:
SELECT ROUND(100 * (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2026 THEN nr END) / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN nr END) - 1), 2)
FROM (SELECT fiscal_year, MEASURE(net_revenue) AS nr FROM workspace.gold.sales_metrics GROUP BY fiscal_year)

FROM workspace.gold.fact_orders o

LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_usd) AS refund_usd
